title: Systemic immune-inflammation index and systemic inflammation response index in obstructive sleep apnoea: A systematic review and meta-analysis
html: Obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA) involves the repetitive collapse of the upper airway, leading to sleep fragmentation, hypoxaemia, hypercapnia, and increased sympathetic activity, with potential physiological consequences including increased oxidative stress, endothelial dysfunction, metabolic dysregulation, a tendency towards coagulation, and chronic systemic inflammation. The purpose of this systematic review was to determine whether the systemic immune-inflammation index (SII) and systemic inflammation response index (SIRI) are reliable markers for detecting systemic inflammation in patients diagnosed with OSA, and whether they can predict its severity.
